title: Column generation: full-graph pricing closure
caption: Separate columns show Phase I dimensionless pricing and Phase II minute-valued pricing. Upper panels preserve every saved full-graph minimum with its phase-specific negative-reduced-cost gate (−1e−8 and −1e−7). Lower panels show the actual saved four-commodity reduced costs, T01–T04, across every round; their matrix minimum is checked against the plotted minimum for every state. Each heatmap has its own explicitly labelled scale and units. The final Phase I minimum is 0; final Phase II minimum is −3.552713678800501e−15 min, satisfying the frozen full-graph closure gate. Linear axes retain signed roundoff; no positive floor or smoothed pricing history is added. Chicago Jane Byrne / West Loop R2 T4 engineering pulse; modelled scenario, not observed traffic. CG is accepted on its own independently checked full-graph primal/dual pricing certificate. The separate HiGHS LP is resource-limited and is not plotted as an accepted reference. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
